sentences.text: This animal is known only from its distinctively ordered plates.
These plates resemble those of the Late Llandovery yunnanolepid Shimenolepis.
Zhanjilepis belongs to the class Placodermi, a group of armored fish.
It is part of the parent group Antiarchi.
Specifically, it is an extinct member of the yunnanolepid group of placoderms.
Zhanjilepis lived during the Lochkovian stage, between 419.62 and 413.02 million years ago.
Fossils of Zhanjilepis aspartilis have been found in Pridoli and Lochkovian rocks in Hunan, China.
